question.text: The Disclosure Document must be provided to a prospective PMS client:

answer.text: Along with the account opening form prior to agreement signing

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation requires DD delivery with AOF, BEFORE agreement signing, with audit trail. The Trap: Post-signing delivery defeats its purpose. Cross-Exam Context: Same in III-A, XXIV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain timestamped proof (email/audit trail) that DD was delivered before signing.
